InstanceTls.description:
The TLS of a runtime's connections (IMPLEMENTATION.md §6, §9).

Every file is a secret reference: the controller holds the material, and the
definition names it. The certificate, the key, and the trust anchor are DER files;
the intermediates link the certificate to the trust anchor, in chain order.

certificate.description: The runtime's certificate, as a secret reference (DER).
certificate.title: Certificate

intermediates.description: The intermediate certificates, in chain order (DER).
intermediates.title: Intermediates

key.description: The private key of the certificate, as a secret reference (DER).
key.title: Key

server_name.description: For a client: the name the station's certificate is checked against. Without it, the client checks the address it connects to.
server_name.title: Server Name

trust.description: The root certificate that signs the peer's certificate (DER).
trust.title: Trust

Publication.description:
A station's IEC 104 port made reachable from outside Docker (§6, task X2).

The station listens on `port` inside the bench, so that port is imposed, and the
engine publishes it on `bind`:`host_port`. `advertise` is the endpoint an external
client is given: it is declared, never discovered.

advertise.description: The host name or address an external client connects to.
advertise.title: Advertise

bind.description: The host address the port is published on. The default keeps it on the loopback; a wider address is an explicit choice.
bind.title: Bind

host_port.description: The host port the engine publishes.
host_port.title: Host Port

port.description: The station's port in the bench.
port.title: Port
